layer.ethernet.note.kid: Each box on the way takes off this envelope and puts on a new one for the next cable.
layer.ethernet.note.nerd: Link-local only: a new frame with new MAC addresses is written for every hop.
layer.ethernet.vlan.kid: It gets a coloured tag so the operator knows which street and which house it came from.
layer.ethernet.vlan.nerd: Double-tagged (Q-in-Q): an S-VLAN per cabinet, a C-VLAN per customer, towards the BNG.
